candidate.blueprint_locator: 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan, Management of Care, printed p.7 / PDF p.11
candidate.educational_objective: Identify the Nurse Practice Act and related jurisdictional rules and regulations as the legal basis for nursing scope of practice.

options.B: A single federal law that is identical in every state
options.C: Each nurse's individual judgment about permitted activities
options.D: The jurisdiction's Nurse Practice Act and related rules and regulations

candidate.rationale: NCSBN states that safe, competent nursing practice is grounded in the state Nurse Practice Act and state rules and regulations. Together, these laws and rules guide and govern nursing practice within the jurisdiction. Facility policy may further direct practice but does not replace the legal scope established by the jurisdiction.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Nursing practice is grounded in the jurisdiction's Nurse Practice Act and state rules/regulations, which together guide and govern nursing practice.
candidate.source_document_title: Find Your Nurse Practice Act; Nurse Practice Act Toolkit
candidate.source_locator: Find Your Nurse Practice Act > introductory text; Nurse Practice Act Toolkit > Nurse Practice Act and Rules/Regulations
candidate.source_organization: National Council of State Boards of Nursing (NCSBN)
candidate.stem: Which source establishes the legal scope of nursing practice in a U.S. jurisdiction?
